description: The inline form of Jest's documented custom snapshot matcher (B23e, D128): `toMatchTrimmedInlineSnapshot` calls jest-snapshot 30.5.2's `toMatchInlineSnapshot` with its `this`. A first local run writes each snapshot into the test file at the custom matcher's call (State.ts `_addSnapshot` finds it below the external matcher trap; `prettierPath: null`, so Babel's reprint alone), then the captured run under `--ci` matches the written snapshots, beside a `toMatchSnapshot` of the same test. One file, one worker.
